options.name: ca_bundle
options.description: Path of a CA bundle used to validate the Horizon instance SSL certificate.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Path of a client certificate. Required if you use certificate based authentication

options.name: client_key
options.description: Path to the private key used for client-certificate authentication. Required if you use certificate based authentication. Restrict access to the key and inventory configuration files.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the controller to establish a connection to Horizon.

options.name: contact_email
options.description: Certificate's contact email. Default value will be the requester contact email address.

options.name: csr
options.description: A certificate signing request, or the path to the CSR file. If none is provided, one will be generated on-the-fly.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Your Horizon instance base endpoint. It must include the protocol (https://) and no trailing slash nor path.

options.name: key_type
options.description: Key type to use when generating a key pair. If omitted, the default key type from the certificate profile is used. This option is not required when O(csr) contains an existing certificate signing request.

options.name: labels
options.description: Certificate's labels.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Certificate metadata as key-value pairs.

options.name: mode
options.description: Enrollment mode. If empty, will be inferred from the Horizon certificate profile configuration.

options.name: owner
options.description: Certificate's owner.

options.name: password
options.description: Security password for the certificate. Password policies will be applied to check validity. Required only if the enrollment is centralized and the password generation mode is not random. Can also be required if the profile allows both centralized and decentralized enrollment with manual password generation. In that case, a password is necessary for decentralized enrollment.

options.name: profile
options.description: Name of the profile that will be used to request the enrollment of the certificate.

options.name: read_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait between response reads by the controller after connecting to Horizon.

options.name: requester_comment
options.description: Free-text field editable by the requester to provide more context on the request.

options.name: sans
options.description: Certificate's subject alternative names (SANs) of the certificate. Authorized values are: [dnsname, rfc822name, ipaddress, othername_upn, othername_guid, uri].

options.name: subject
options.description: Certificate's subject. You can either give the description of the subject, or the full DN. If you give the DN, other values won't be used.

options.name: team
options.description: Certificate's team.

options.name: x_api_id
options.description: Horizon identifier Required if you use credentials authentication

options.name: x_api_key
options.description: Secret API key used for Horizon credential authentication. Required if you use credentials authentication. Store this value with Ansible Vault. Tasks containing lookup expressions with this value should use C(no_log=true).
